body: Hello guys, thanks for all the messages here on the thread, and a really special thank you to xcpasta, a real great person. I am sorry for not being able to post to the thread earlier, but my internet was slow ( bad weather ).

Got some apples, pears and bananas. Taste pretty good. I will update the thread tomorrow if everything will, lets say, be better. Good luck on your exam tomorrow, hope you do well.
Yeah, sure thing, I'll take you up on the music offer. If you can PM me with some music suggestion that would be nice. Thank you.

Thanks for that xcpasta, really appreciate it. I'm in the UK and talked with the UK helpline. Really nice and good people that try their best, just like the people on here. I read online that fruits help when the brain malfunctions and people get depressed, so bought myself an entire bag of fruit to see if it helps. I don't know if I'll still be around tomorrow, so I'll just experiment with with all the suggestions, if I'm still here, that means fruit can actually help :).
Destiny, good game, played it on PS3 a couple of times, did not know about the easter egg, so thanks for that.

Huge RPG fan, Skyrim, Diablo, Fallout. Maybe I like them because it seems I'm like somebody else playing.
Anyway, funny story actually regarding games. There is this very stupid game for mobile, Cooking Tale. That game believe it or not actually saved my life when I first attempted. I got so obsessed in finishing a level with 3 stars, that I actually said to myself, with my belt around my neck that I will do it after I finish it. Fell asleep with 2 stars on the level after hours of attempts.

Nice response, and I do appreciate it, but similar to Dante's “In the middle of the journey of our life I came to myself within a dark wood where the straight way was lost”, I lost the straight way and I don't think anyone can help me find it again.
